from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/projects/{project_id}/documents/{document_id}")
async def get_document(
    project_id: str,
    document_id: str,
    user = Depends(require_project_member),
):
    svc = DocumentService()
    document = await svc.get(document_id, project_id=project_id)
    return document
